diff --git a/wordpress/wordpress_test.go b/wordpress/wordpress_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6d2a568
--- /dev/null
+++ b/wordpress/wordpress_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+package wordpress
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
+)
+
+func TestRemoveInactives(t *testing.T) {
+	packages := models.WordPressPackages{
+		{Name: "core", Type: models.WPCore},
+		{Name: "active-plugin", Type: models.WPPlugin, Status: "active"},
+		{Name: "inactive-plugin", Type: models.WPPlugin, Status: models.Inactive},
+		{Name: "inactive-theme", Type: models.WPTheme, Status: models.Inactive},
+		{Name: "must-use-plugin", Type: models.WPPlugin, Status: "must-use"},
+	}
+
+	filtered := removeInactives(packages)
+	if len(filtered) != 3 || filtered[0].Name != "core" || filtered[1].Name != "active-plugin" || filtered[2].Name != "must-use-plugin" {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected filtered packages: %+v", filtered)
+	}
+	if len(packages) != 5 {
+		t.Fatalf("input was modified: %+v", packages)
+	}
+	if got := removeInactives(models.WordPressPackages{{Status: models.Inactive}}); got != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("expected nil when all packages are inactive, got %+v", got)
+	}
+}
